title: VERIFY: Is Walmart giving away $250 gift cards?
description: A link is being shared that claims you have been given a $250 gift card to Walmart, but is it true?

asr.full_text: It is Verify time and today our fact checkers are taking a closer look at this very tempting offer. It claims you've been given a $250 gift card to Walmart. All you have to do is click on the link to start the so-called verification process. Well, our source on this one, we go straight to Walmart. This man right here, the senior manager with corporate communications for Walmart, he told us this. There are no promotions or incentive programs that lead to a Walmart gift card. In fact, these types of scams are so common, Walmart has created a page on its website to help viewers spot all these fakes. And from the tech experts we spoke to, this one looks like one of those phishing scams where hackers are trying to get your info when you click on that verification link. So, after all this, we can verify the Walmart gift card promotion really is too good be true. It is false and a fake. So, do you have something you want our Verify team to look into?
